zone_dx2700.note: an 800-px box does not fit inside L's 5830-px canvas at dx -2700 (x 214); 400-px boxes and top-15 on all four arms, like for like; GO #5's rules applied

reading: BY THE PRE-REGISTERED LETTER: every position reads NEITHER — including the controls — because the rule's +0.10 px allowance over the member median is smaller than the compose's own measured floor: at the clean control x50 the 77-member corpus reads +0.165 px FWHM over the covering members' median (2.542 vs 2.377) while ROUNDER than it (+0.019), and at the mirror control x90 +0.192 px (2 members). The +0.10 bar was set from GO #5's lineage (+0.16 px stacking/resampling floor) and the floor measured here is that figure, not below it — the rule as written cannot return MEMBER-BORNE anywhere on this corpus. IN SUBSTANCE, calibrated by the controls: at the defect positions the corpus exceeds the covering members' median FWHM by +0.230 (x10) / +0.270 (x15) / +0.274 (x20) / +0.197 (x25) px, i.e. +0.065 / +0.105 / +0.109 / +0.032 px beyond the x50 control's compose excess, and its ROUNDNESS is at or above the member median everywhere (+0.046 / +0.024 / +0.008 / +0.013 vs the control's +0.019) — the 0.84-0.85 roundness of the band is what the covering members themselves read at those columns (median 0.80-0.84; best july31/set-01 0.93-0.98; worst aug14/set-04 and set-05 0.66-0.72, aug09/set-04 and set-05 0.75-0.77). MEMBER-BORNE in substance, with a compose contribution equal to its own baseline (+0.03..+0.11 px FWHM above the control's floor, no roundness cost). COMPOSE-ADDED is refuted on roundness at every defect position (the corpus is never less round than the member median) and the FWHM excess over the BEST member (+0.50..+0.67 px) is the mixing of good and bad members, not a compose defect: the corpus lands between the nightly medians (july31 2.39-2.73 / aug06 2.65-2.67 / aug09 2.72-3.03 / aug14 3.12-3.34). THE ZONE READING: every covering column at x10-x25 is an ENTRY-side column of its member — 0 of 111 (member, position) pairs lie within 400 px of any edge, but ALL lie 400-1470 px from the ENTRY (right, high-RA) edge and none from the exit edge or the interior-left: the corpus's left band is built exclusively from the members' right-hand, high-RA fifth. The corpus canvas is RA-flipped relative to every member (RA falls with corpus x; rises with member x, so the members' exit edge is x=1 for all 77), so the corpus's LEFT rim is the members' ENTRY side. x05 and x95 are UNATTRIBUTABLE by this design (no member holds a full 800-px box: 13 partial members each, the x05 ones at -395..+231 px of their entry edge, the x95 ones at -398..+200 px of their exit edge). THE ELONGATION IS DRIFT-ALIGNED, not the GO #5 entry-side signature: the corpus band's major axis is 1-8 deg from local +RA with e 0.16 (R 0.93-0.99), and the covering members' own top-30 at those columns read a median 2.4-9.5 deg from THEIR local +RA with e 0.18-0.21 — the members carry a drift-aligned elongation at their entry-side columns, which GO #5's set-01 stations at +1800/+2400 did NOT show (11-37 deg off RA there). The night dependence is the dominant term: aug14 members read 3.1-3.4 px / 0.66-0.75 at these columns, july31 members 2.2-2.7 / 0.80-0.98, under one lens — so the entry-side degradation is not a fixed property of the lens alone (temperature/focus/night: unmeasured; aug14/set-04's 'intrinsically soft field-edge PSF' in member_solve_scale_band_fix is the same observation). THE OUTERMOST EXIT ZONE (dx -2700 on the span arms, 400-px box, top 15): FLAT across a 9x span — S 2.485/0.957, M 2.485/0.981, L 2.495/0.983, P 2.490/0.972 (L-S +0.010 px; S the LEAST round) — GO #5's exit-side verdict holds in the zone it skipped; the mirror dx +2700 rises with span, S 2.455/0.908 -> M 2.480/0.891 -> L 2.550/0.879 (+0.095 px, -0.029 roundness), P 2.505/0.883 — the entry-side span dependence again, drift-off-axis (dev 15-24 deg, e 0.10-0.13) as at +2400.

verdict_in_substance: MEMBER-BORNE: the left band's shape is what the members' own entry-side (high-RA, right-hand) columns read; the compose adds its baseline (+0.165 px at the clean control) plus 0.03-0.11 px, and no roundness. The rule's +0.10 allowance was below the compose's measured floor — a flaw of the pre-registered bar, recorded, not silently re-scored.
premises_untested: that the corpus's box at a sky position samples the same stars as the members' boxes there (the same RA/Dec, the tool's own box-centre verification 0.03-0.62 deg; the corpus is deeper — its n is ~1.5-2x a member's — and the top-30 by amplitude rank-matches, not the same 30 stars)

that 'covering' = a full 800-px box inside the member (the compose blends any covered pixel, including the partial members excluded here; at x10 the 4 covering members are a subset of the 34 that touch it)

the nbstack-weighted compose is a weighted MEAN of covering members: the corpus's reading should sit near the members' weighted mean, not their median — the median was the pre-registered comparator; the by-night medians bracket the corpus at every defect position
the y-down convention for +RA (y-up recorded beside every angle in the state file; the drift axis is near-horizontal in every member, ambiguity <= ~12 deg at these columns)

the control-calibrated reading subtracts one control's excess from the defect positions; the two controls differ (+0.165 vs +0.192) and the compose floor could vary with position (member count 77 at x50, 2 at x90)
x05 and x95 unattributed by design; a 400-px supplement on the partial members was not run (outside the pre-registration)
the night dependence is observed, its cause (focus, temperature, the in-exposure trail direction per night) is not measured here
no_destructive_steps: no product written or modified; lists and shape JSONs under sessions/<night>/work/smear_attr/ and sessions/aug06/work/spanarm/<arm>/zone2700/ (gitignored)

v2_correction.what: GO #11 (director astro-imaging-45, worker astro-imaging-7f): every box of this record re-measured with the FIXED shape_at_sky.py (both crop conventions run, the smaller median offset accepted only where the passes differ by more than the tolerance; one sentinel position 1200 px above each image's centre row makes every set decisive). The primary numbers in corpus.positions, member_shape[*].positions, per_position, control_calibration, verdict_by_the_letter and per_night_at_defect_positions are now the corrected-placement readings; the displaced originals sit beside them under *_v1_displaced_placement with each box's displacement named. reading / verdict_in_substance / instrument / premises_untested describe the v1 run and are untouched — this block and ledger line 108 carry the correction.
v2_correction.why: the v1 instrument accepted the first crop convention whose boxes all verified within tol = 2.83 deg (~600 px); the wrong convention displaces a box by 2*|y0 - H/2| px, so mid-row box sets verified under the wrong convention (registry: docs/dead-ends/verification-traps.md, the shape_at_sky crop-flip entry; the fix + --selftest in scripts/qa/shape_at_sky.py, roster row in run_guards.sh)
